/local-evals.md): Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test with local results and an MCPJam identity\n52:- [
CI / CD](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/ci.md): Run MCP health checks, conformance suites, and evals in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, an
d other CI environments\n71:- [EvalSuite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/eval-suite.md): API reference for EvalSuite\n73:-
[runSuiteFile](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/run-suite-file.md): API reference for running an MCPJam suite file locally fr
om code\n88:- [Create an eval run (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-run-async.md): Creates a
suite run from an existing `suiteId` (rerun) and/or inline `tests`, then **detaches execution and responds `202` immediately** wi
th the `runId`. Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` for progress. The run appears l
ive in the hosted UI Runs tab,…\n98:- [List a suite's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-runs.md)
: Recent runs for a suite, newest first.\n99:- [List a suite's per-run stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval
-runs/list-a-suites-per-run-stage-analytics.md): One materialized stage-analytics document per RUN, newest completion first: where
trials fell out of the six-stage user-value chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, user value), overall an
d sliced marginally by intent, model and host.\n101:- [Get one run's suite quality-gate report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
nce/eval-runs/get-one-runs-suite-quality-gate-report.md): ONE run's stored suite quality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1`): passed
, failed, non_gateable, or not_configured.\n102:- [Enable, repoint, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/eval-runs/enable-repoint-or-disable-a-suites-schedule.md): A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval, so an environment
-based suite must pin exactly one of its attached environments. Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environment suite means that
environment; omitting it on a multi-environment suite is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…\n104:- [Create an eval
suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite-author-only-does-not-run.
md): Creates a runnable eval suite — the suite record plus its test cases — and responds `201` **synchronously**, WITHOUT executin
g anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST /eval-runs` (passing the returned `suiteId`).\n105:- [Resolve
or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-owned-eval-suite.md):
Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declaredSuiteId)` and neve
r by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector parses the suite file; this body is the dec
lared identity, source hash, optional pro…\n106:- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-
runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings — attached environments, hosts, execution config, judge, sch
edule. The list route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.\n107:- [Delete an eval suite]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the suite and its cases. Past runs are not dele
ted.\n108:- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md):
Partial update — omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clear
s (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds with the full upd
ated suite.\n109:- [Get the pre-run disclosure for a suite launch plan](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-the-pr
e-run-disclosure-for-a-suite-launch-plan.md): What happens to a run's content BEFORE you launch it: which models it calls and wher
e they route, which LLM analyzers/judges can fire and where their evidence goes, capture/retention/region facts, and the subproces
sors engaged. Read-only — never launches or gates a run. Keyed by the SAME destination…\n110:- [List a suite's eval cases](https:/
/docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the suite, in the public steps-first shape.\n
111:- [Create an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case.md): Adds one case to the suite. B
oth `title` and a non-empty `steps` array are required — `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partial, but
a case persisted without executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.\n112:-
[Create several eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up to 100 cases to
the suite in one call — the bulk form of the single create, and the way to import a suite or convert a repo's test files without
a round trip per case. Every entry needs a `title` and a non-empty `steps` array. Cases are validated together and reported indivi
dually: a `failed…\n113:- [Generate eval cases from the suite's tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/generate-ev
al-cases-from-the-suites-tools.md): Discovers the suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, generates cases against them, a
nd persists them — the only edit route that connects to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate, persist, disconnect, respond.\n1
14:- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): Th
e sibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person alread
y wrote — a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered s
teps, tool calls, assertions), so the…\n116:- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite. A draft carr
ying unresolved blocking issues or proposed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back under `skipped` with a `r
eviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.\n117:- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-cas
e.md): A case that belongs to this suite and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n118:- [Delete an eval case](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the suite. Past runs that executed it
